description.value: Gee! Taste Good is a family-owned Southeast Asian food court stall that has occupied its original spot inside Pacific Plaza in Richmond for over twenty-five years, founded by immigrants from Southeast Asia. It specializes in authentic Indonesian and Malaysian fare — laksa, nasi goreng, rendang, gado-gado, and traditional desserts — earning a reputation as a hidden gem within Greater Vancouver. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond will find it a welcoming stop for a substantial, flavourful meal in a casual food court setting.
